Sandbox_KBW_ReplaceBuildMenu_tooltip: The sidebar Build button opens Knox Buildworks instead of the vanilla Build Menu. When this is off, the Build button keeps vanilla as the primary action and exposes Knox Buildworks from its hover drawer.
Sandbox_KBW_EnablePlanningMode_tooltip: Allow players to open Knox Planning Mode for blueprints, ghost overlays, and build queues. Admins can turn this off for stricter servers.
Sandbox_KBW_MaxPlacementsPerBlueprint_to: Upper limit of ghost placements a single blueprint can hold.
Sandbox_KBW_BuildXPMultiplier_tooltip: Multiplies the XP awarded when a Knox Buildworks construction finishes.
Sandbox_KBW_BlueprintRadius_tooltip: Half-size of the square a blueprint may cover, measured from its first ghost. 200 gives a 400x400 area.
Sandbox_KBW_WellWaterMode_tooltip: Choose whether water wells provide unlimited clean water or use a finite reservoir that refills from groundwater and rain.
Sandbox_KBW_WellCapacity_tooltip: Maximum litres stored by each limited water well.
Sandbox_KBW_WellInitialPercent_tooltip: Percentage of a limited well's capacity available when the well is first built.
Sandbox_KBW_WellHourlyRefill_tooltip: Litres of clean water naturally restored to each limited well every in-game hour.
Sandbox_KBW_WellRainRefillMultiplier_too: Multiplies the well's native Build 42 rain-catcher factor. Set this to 0 to disable rain refilling.
Sandbox_KBW_RequireConstructionPaint_too: Require paint and a paintbrush for pre-colored Expanded recipes and selected wall finishes during construction. Disable to build those colors without paint. Does not change vanilla painting of existing walls or bucket capacity.
